reported: After the boosted Horde Hunter completed The Battle for Broken Shore, the tracker showed ready for turn-in but Eitrigg on the Bladefist Bay dock had no marker and right-click opened no window.

observed_data.name: Eitrigg
observed_data.flag_selection: Native ObjectMgr::ChooseCreatureFlags uses the template's questgiver flag when the spawn override is zero.
observed_data.phase: Completed 40518, before rewarded 40522, admits Durotar phase definition 4 / phase 7425; the correct Eitrigg is visible at the reported dock.
observed_data.acceptance_conflict: Source-19 acceptance conditions require preparation quest 44281 rewarded. The legitimate boost-ship route begins at 40518 and does not reward the skipped preparations.

cause: Player::GetQuestDialogStatus reapplied QUEST_ACCEPT conditions to involved relations before reading active quest status. The skipped preparation made it return None instead of RewardCompletePOI even though the existing quest was complete. The fixture reproduces this with the actual old production function. The exact client's absent right-click packet was not captured; the relationship between the missing marker and right-click behavior still needs the client retest.
reference: The local C:/wamp64/www/TrinityCore Player::GetQuestDialogStatus also treats involved-quest status separately from start-quest conditions. Its newer protocol was not copied.

fix.behavior: Read the involved quest status first. Existing COMPLETE/INCOMPLETE quests retain their turn-in/incomplete marker even when acceptance prerequisites no longer pass. Source 19 still applies for other statuses and the starter relation loop.
